## How to test

## Checklist

- [ ] PR title follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:` …)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under *Unreleased* (user-facing changes)
- [ ] Core logic covered by unit tests (`./gradlew :core:test -PcoreOnly=true`)
- [ ] Screenshots added for UI changes
